spec: Fix the disposer leak and add a test asserting _weak is cleaned.
diff:
diff --git a/src/demo.py b/src/demo.py
--- a/src/demo.py
+++ b/src/demo.py
@@ -1 +1,10 @@
-old
+class DisposableList:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._sn = 0
+        self._map = {}
+        self._weak = {}
+    def push(self, value):
+        self._sn += 1
+        sn = self._sn
+        self._map[sn] = value
+        self._weak[value] = sn
+        def dispose():
+            self._map.pop(sn, None)
+            if self._weak.get(value) == sn:
+                self._weak.pop(value, None)
+        return dispose
diff --git a/tests/test_weak.py b/tests/test_weak.py
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_weak.py
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+from demo import DisposableList
+
+def test_disposer_clears_weak():
+    d = DisposableList()
+    dispose = d.push("a")
+    dispose()
+    assert d._weak == {}
